art_note: The flat product shots are clean, but the lifestyle model images present an artificial composited aesthetic that detracts from luxury positioning.
desc_en: An avant-garde intimate piece that redefines the silhouette with a dynamic digital spirit. This design features a sophisticated all-inclusive continuous gradient print in tones of cyan, deep violet, and fuchsia, enhanced by a precise halftone dot pattern. Engineered to provide a lightweight and tailored wearing experience, it incorporates an elastic waistband ensuring optimal support with total discretion. The signature monogram seals the garment with exclusive character. Crafted exclusively to order.
desc_es: Una propuesta íntima de vanguardia que redefine la silueta con un espíritu digital y dinámico. Esta pieza presenta un sofisticado estampado integral de degradado continuo en tonos cian, violeta profundo y fucsia, realzado por una precisa trama de medios tonos. Diseñada para ofrecer una experiencia de uso ligera y precisa, incorpora una cinturilla elástica que asegura un soporte óptimo con total discreción. El monograma distintivo sella la prenda con carácter exclusivo. Fabricada bajo demanda.
